<style>
  .student-card {
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 20px;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    transition: transform 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
  }
  .student-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    border-color: #b01c2e;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  }
  .student-img {
    width: 65px;
    height: 65px;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
  }
  .student-supervisor {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    background: #f8fafc;
    padding: 10px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    margin-top: auto; /* Empurra o supervisor e o link para a base do card */
  }
  .student-link {
    color: #b01c2e;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    margin-top: 10px;
    display: inline-block;
  }
  .student-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }
</style>
